seoTitle: Shipping Box Volume and Item Fit Calculator
metaDescription: Find box volume in litres and how many items fit in a grid in the best of six orientations. Free, runs offline in your browser.
intro: Gives the volume of a box and counts how many identical items fit in a simple grid in the best orientation.
why:
Choosing a box by volume alone overestimates what fits, because items are rigid. A grid count in the best orientation is a safer figure, though not perfect.

The tool tries all six ways to rotate the item, counts how many fit along each side, and reports the best count next to the volume-only limit. Mixed orientations can fit more, and padding takes room, so confirm with a real box.
howTo: Read the fit count and the space used.

faq.q: Why is the grid count lower than the volume limit?
faq.a: Items have fixed shapes and leave gaps. The volume limit assumes perfect filling.
No. All items share one orientation, which is easy to pack.

faq.q: Should I use inner or outer size?
faq.a: Inner size, minus any padding you add.
